candidate_relations.reason: CM-AVM syndrome is a RASA1 fast-flow disorder; this is slow-flow KRIT1 familial cavernous malformation disease.
Epilepsy is a manifestation of cerebral cavernomas, not the familial cavernous malformation diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Childhood seizures as a CCM manifestation

candidate_relations.reason: Vascular malformation is the parent category and omits familial cerebral cavernous malformation with KRIT1.
Cutaneovisceral angiomatosis with thrombocytopenia is a different multifocal vascular syndrome, not KRIT1 cavernous malformations.
Hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia is a different hereditary vascular dysplasia from KRIT1 cerebral cavernous malformations.
Familial cerebral cavernous malformation matches KRIT1-pathogenic familial disease with ICH, seizures, and cutaneous slow-flow venous lesions.
